decision: Keep the adaptive 18-patch cover and replace the diagonal nonnegative cone with a full PSD Gram variable.
why: Adaptive anisotropic refinement removes the coarse near-axis catastrophe.
All 18 local floating sign audits pass, so local sign engineering is no longer the first bottleneck.
The diagonal stage-one LP agrees with the best single ray to numerical precision.
All partial global budgets remain negative by factors of roughly 9 to 20.
required_formulation: Core blocks are linear trace constraints in A.
Arithmetic positivity is a linear trace constraint in A.
Axis band energy is a linear trace objective in A.
Guard and roughness budgets are explicit constraints.
The diagonal-cone solution is retained as a baseline.
stop_rules: Do not start interval rounding unless the floating full budget has a substantial positive safety factor.
Do not claim global dominance without unknown off-axis and tail charges.
Do not use known zero ordinates as optimization equalities.
If full Gram remains negative across support and rank sweeps, report a structural frontier rather than tuning indefinitely.
success_rule: A candidate passes only when arithmetic positivity and the complete global domination gap are both strictly positive under outward interval validation.
